छठ पूजा की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ

Happy Chhath Puja

May the first light of the rising sun bring health, peace and joy to you and your family.

सूर्य देव और छठी मैया

Chhath is a festival of gratitude. Families thank the Sun God for light and life, and Chhathi Maiya for the health of their children.

सूर्य देव

The giver of light and life. Devotees stand in the river at dusk and dawn to offer him arghya.

छठी मैया

The protective mother who blesses families with health, long life and the well-being of children.

Four days at the river

The festival follows the sun, from a simple meal to the final offering at sunrise.

Day 1

नहाय-खाय

Devotees bathe in the river, clean the home and eat a simple meal of kaddu-bhaat (bottle gourd and rice).

Day 2

खरना

A day of fasting without water. After sunset, families share rasiya kheer and roti as prasad.

Day 3

संध्या अर्घ्य

At the riverbank, baskets of thekua, fruit and sugarcane are raised as the first offering to the setting sun.

Day 4

उषा अर्घ्य

At dawn, the final arghya goes to the rising sun. Then the fast is broken with prasad and blessings.
